key.decision_why: The author used zulipbot to remove a "not ready" label a maintainer had just added, and no maintainer is assigned, so the triager needs to see it and respond.
key.action_why: laurynmm re-added "not ready" and told the author to follow the reviewable-PR guide and not to remove maintainer labels; later she asked for context from an issue or community discussion.
changed: The author force-pushed five times and squashed the two commits into one, so the PR went from +49/-4 to +38/-4 in the same two files.
The author removed the "not ready" label through zulipbot instead of asking for another look.
still_missing: There is no linked issue or chat.zulip.org discussion explaining the bug and why this fix is wanted.
The description is thin, and its self-review checklist does not match Zulip's pull request template.
Nothing shows the author addressed whatever made the PR "not ready"; only the commits were squashed.
key.reply_ask: Ask the author not to remove labels that maintainers add, to follow the guide on submitting reviewable PRs, and to give context by linking a tracked issue or starting a chat.zulip.org discussion.

must_have.fact: Says the author removed the maintainer-added "not ready" label themselves with zulipbot, and that the label should be restored and the author asked not to do this.
Says the PR has no linked issue or chat.zulip.org discussion giving context for the fix.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and giving more feedback rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Says the only code change since the label was squashing two commits into one in the same files, with no substantive change.
Notes that the description's self-review checklist does not match Zulip's pull request template.
